fields.label: Section
fields.note: Repeatable checkbox name in form#ajax-careers-search-filter; the jQuery serialization also carries the hidden selected-job-sections field (IDs 323,325,324,326).

fields.label: Experience level
fields.note: Repeatable checkbox name in the listing filter form.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Repeatable checkbox name; region rows (europe/americas/asia-pacific) and city rows share the same parameter.

notes: The Open Opportunities page embeds form#ajax-careers-search-filter, which POSTs to https://www.citadelsecurities.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php with action=careers_listing_filter, jobTitle, sections-filter/experience-filter/location-filter checkboxes, current_page, sort_order=DESC and per_page=10. The page JS (careerListingFilter) serializes the form, appends jobTitle/current_page/action and also mirrors the same pairs into the page URL. GET /careers/open-opportunities/page/<n>/ serves the same unfiltered cards.
